comment: Routing probes for C compilation, header classification, C++ near-neighbors, and mixed-language composition.

queries.query: Fix the overflow in src/frame.c when an untrusted length is multiplied before allocation.
Update include/device.h; compile_commands.json shows it is included by three C11 translation units built with clang.
Add a function to this C library that parses a length-prefixed record stream from a caller-supplied buffer and returns an array of records.
Fix a pthread shutdown race in worker_pool.c: workers poll a volatile flag and can touch the shared queue after main frees it.
Use $c-development to review this C cleanup path and preserve the library ABI.
Refactor widget.h, which is included only by .cpp files and defines templates, std::span parameters, and a C++20 concept.
Change the CMake compile features for a target containing only C++ sources; no C target or C-facing header is involved.
Change api.h, which is compiled into a C shared library and included directly by supported C++ consumers through extern C.
